experimental_question: With tags placed in a compact area near one gateway to make at least one RF path likely, does the existing ns-3 PHY show lower PDR under exact synchronization than deterministic per-device seeded phase scheduling, with the same RF inputs and PHY configuration?

design.tag_positions: Identical deterministic gateway-near placement in each paired pattern; tags are within 50 m of GW-1. Other gateways remain at their original campaign positions.

traffic_patterns.SYNCHRONIZED: Source timestamp scheduling; all tags transmit at each shared epoch.
traffic_patterns.SEEDED_PHASE: Existing FREQUENCIA deterministic per-device offset in [0, cadence); the offset repeats at every epoch. This is not per-packet randomization or jitter.

design.localization_claim: Input availability only; the gateway-near geometry may not provide 3 distinct received anchors.
design.duration_note: Three TX epochs per tag as already supported by the campaign runner. Results are an existence/causal-mechanism probe, not a statistical capacity estimate.

interpretation.collision_attribution: Only gateway PHY INTERFERENCE events are attributed to modeled interference. NO_PATH and other outcomes remain separate.
interpretation.capacity: No tag-count maximum or robust/overload boundary may be inferred from this three-epoch two-pattern probe.
interpretation.duty_cycle: NOT_MODELED: FREQUENCIA configures synthetic sub-band duty limit 1.0 (unrestricted).
interpretation.gateway_failure: NOT_MODELED: no availability/offline/recovery switch exists in this scenario interface.
interpretation.application_delivery: NOT_MODELED: terminal metric is gateway PHY reception.
